name: Stablecoin ETH-share rotation -> fast ETH deployment probe (4h, fractional hold)
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM (distinct from the daily ETH-share variants: this trades the SAME rotation-nowcast thesis on a 4h clock with a sub-day-to-2-day hold, targeting the fast window between stablecoins landing on ETH rails and their deployment moving ETH spot before it is common knowledge): a rising stablecoin_eth_share is a directional bet that ETH deployment is imminent; on a 4h bar the earliest deployment can be captured. Entry: eth_share momentum up AND price momentum non-negative on the 4h clock. Fast exit on share fade or stop/TP/time. DISCONFIRMER 1: eth_share is a slow, revised on-chain series -> on a 4h clock it likely updates too coarsely to give distinct intraday signal, and fee drag is heavy; KILL unless the net-of-fee edge clears DSR>=0.95. DISCONFIRMER 2: if the daily variant (16) captures all of it, the fast clock adds nothing. DISCONFIRMER 3: issuer-mechanic jumps dominate; require the signal not be one discrete step. High death probability — a frequency probe. Net of fees.
catalyst: ETH-share rotation deploying to ETH spot within hours
